summation.displayName: MAPK14 (p38 alpha) and MAPK11 (p38 beta) phosphorylate MAPKA...
summation.text: MAPK14 (p38 alpha) and MAPK11 (p38 beta) phosphorylate MAPKAPK5 (PRAK) on threonine residue 182, located in the conserved LMTP site in the T-loop of the kinase domain. Phosphorylation of T182 is necessary for the MAPKAPK5 catalytic activity (New et al. 1998).
